clue.text: Stiffly formal male gets girl embarrassed

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name
someone embarrassed goes red in the face

explanation.surface: A man turns crimson when a young woman catches him being stiff and starchy.
explanation.definitionFit: Speech or behaviour that is affected and artificial, rather than natural, is described this way.

clue.text: Inspired French composer's reserve seeing off a couple of English

indicators.note: seeing off means getting rid of, so the two letters are removed

parts.note: Olivier Messiaen was a French composer
ice means coolness or reserve of manner
E is the abbreviation for English, so two of them

explanation.surface: A French composer's coolness drives away a pair of Englishmen.
explanation.walkthrough: One E goes from the composer's name and the other from the end of ICE.
explanation.definitionFit: Fervent, zealous or visionary, as of a would-be saviour figure, is a sense of prophetic zeal.

clue.text: Arrived at last in a very remote place

definitions.meaning: read as two words: finally arrived
the middle of the back of beyond, a place without a name

explanation.surface: A traveller finally reaches a spot at the end of the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: A place so remote it might as well not exist is described as this, as in the middle of it.

clue.text: A standard some citizens ignore

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A national flag that many citizens pay no heed to.
explanation.definitionFit: A flag or banner, especially one flown by a ship, is a standard.

clue.text: Seaplane departs roughly here?

indicators.note: roughly means imprecisely, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: D is the timetable abbreviation for departs

explanation.surface: A question about where a seaplane takes off on the seafront.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: a seaplane might set off from the seafront promenade.
explanation.definitionFit: A level promenade along a seafront is where a seaplane might plausibly leave from.

clue.text: Men following officer, but this one may have led some into a trap

definitions.text: this one may have led some into a trap

indicators.note: the word for men comes after the officer's abbreviation

parts.note: Capt is the abbreviation for captain, an officer
OR, other ranks, means the ordinary soldiers as opposed to officers

explanation.surface: A tale of soldiers trailing their officer into an ambush he walked them into.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is descriptive: whoever lures or leads others into a trap is the one who catches them.
explanation.definitionFit: One who takes prisoners, often by ensnaring them, is their capturer.

clue.text: What provides trim for boat

definitions.meaning: a tool for cutting hair or hedges
a fast sailing ship of the nineteenth century

explanation.surface: Something that gives a vessel its tidy, shipshape condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Shears or cutters that trim, and the fast tea ships of old, share one name.

clue.text: Toy Story acted on stage has disastrous night

parts.note: a play is a story performed in a theatre

indicators.note: a disastrous night has gone badly wrong, so its letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A review: a stage version of Toy Story suffers a dreadful opening night.
explanation.definitionFit: A child's toy is something to play with.

clue.text: Bird of the greatest magnificence which buries head

indicators.note: losing the head means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: most rich means of the greatest richness or magnificence

explanation.surface: The most splendid bird, which is famed for hiding its head in the sand.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface plays on the myth that this bird buries its head in the sand.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest living flightless species is a bird of Africa.

clue.text: Make clear missing horse is a farm animal

indicators.note: the H is left out of the word for make clear

parts.note: to show something is to make it clear
horse is slang for heroin, abbreviated H

explanation.surface: An instruction about pointing out livestock, minus the horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horse' looks like another farm animal but is drug slang for heroin, H.
explanation.definitionFit: A female pig kept on farms for breeding is called this.

clue.text: Begging to replace current Conservative leader following the left

indicators.note: the two new letters sit right after the L, the abbreviation for left, inside the word for replace

parts.note: to supplant someone is to replace them
I is the symbol for electric current

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Political talk of ousting the Tory leader from the left of the party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following the left' puts IC straight after the L of SUPPLANT, giving SUPPL-IC-ANT.
explanation.definitionFit: A suppliant or petitioner humbly asks for something, so the adjective means pleading.

clue.text: Fish move over before Aries sign

parts.note: the ide is a freshwater fish, a crossword regular

indicators.note: over tells us the word for move is turned round

parts.note: go means move
Aries is the ram of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Instructions for a zodiac chart: shift the fish so it comes before Aries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sign' looks like a zodiac sign, given Aries and Fish (Pisces), but it means a written symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: A written character standing for an idea, as in Chinese script, is a kind of symbol.

clue.text: Dialect father's given to one son

parts.note: pa is father, and the 's stands for is
taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A father passes his local way of speaking on to his only son.
explanation.definitionFit: A regional form of speech, especially a rural one, is a local vernacular.

clue.text: Requirement's captured but tons repeatedly got missed out

definitions.note: Requirement is the definition; the 's stands for is

indicators.note: says the two letters are left out of the word for captured

parts.note: netted means caught or captured

indicators.note: the abbreviation for tons is taken twice

explanation.surface: A report on tonnage being overlooked in the stock taken.
explanation.definitionFit: A necessity or something wanted is a want or necessity: the two nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: Strip down lens and admit components need replacing

indicators.note: the parts must be put back in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Repair advice for a camera: take it apart because parts are worn.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking a machine apart piece by piece means to strip it down.

clue.text: Indisputable what all sailors work on getting drunk

parts.note: sailors do their work on the water
tight is slang for drunk

explanation.surface: A fact beyond argument about seafarers and their habit of getting plastered.
explanation.definitionFit: An argument with no holes in it, which nothing can leak through, is unassailable.

clue.text: Looks at what instructor does which makes it hard to see

definitions.text: which makes it hard to see

parts.note: to eye something is to look at it
an instructor trains people

explanation.surface: A teacher studies his pupils so intently that his vision suffers.
explanation.definitionFit: Tired, aching vision from overuse is a cause of blurred sight.

clue.text: Play remarkably clear tone

indicators.note: remarkably suggests the letters are transformed into something unexpected

explanation.surface: A theatre review praising the singularly pure sound of a performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Play' looks like a drama; here it means slack or allowable movement in machinery.
explanation.definitionFit: The permitted variation or free movement in a mechanism is called its play.

clue.text: Annoyed to get spliff but not all Ecstasy, have recourse to another source

parts.note: cross means annoyed

indicators.note: one E, not both, is dropped from the word for spliff

parts.note: a spliff is a cannabis cigarette, also called a reefer
E is slang for the drug Ecstasy

explanation.walkthrough: 'source' suggests a dealer, but the definition is about consulting another reference.
explanation.definitionFit: To direct a reader to another passage or book for related information is to refer them onward.

clue.text: Dance degree that's served up on a plate

parts.note: the rumba is a Cuban dance
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a degree

explanation.surface: A dance qualification handed over with no effort at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served up on a plate' sounds like easy success; literally, a dessert is served on a plate.
explanation.definitionFit: A rum-soaked sponge cake is a dessert that is brought to the table on a plate.

clue.text: One put out to pasture on Hebridean island

parts.note: re means on or concerning
Tiree is an island in the Inner Hebrides off western Scotland

explanation.surface: An old farmer pensioned off to graze on a Scottish island.
explanation.definitionFit: Put out to pasture is an idiom for someone pensioned off after a working life.

clue.text: Rancour apparent when cries of pain come from gibbet

ow is a cry of pain, so ows are several

clue.text: Cleaner bullets need introducing apace at the front

parts.note: ammo is short for ammunition, bullets

indicators.note: says the first letters of the three words are taken

explanation.surface: An instruction to load bullets fast, about a cleaning product.
explanation.definitionFit: A pungent alkaline solution used in household cleaning fluids is a cleaning agent.

clue.text: Go over what's gone wrong

definitions.meaning: to change sides, abandoning one country for another

explanation.definitionFit: To desert to the other side, and a flaw or fault, are the verb and noun of one word.

clue.text: A big hit is a devil to perform on stage

parts.note: an imp is a little devil
actors act on stage

explanation.surface: A smash hit show starring a demon character.
explanation.definitionFit: A forceful collision or blow, or a strong effect, is a striking contact.

clue.text: Ship carrying queen's flag

indicators.note: the ship holds the queen's letter inside it

parts.note: a steamer is a steamship
R, for Regina, stands for queen

explanation.surface: A vessel flying the royal standard.

clue.text: Lotion used by men — save father, unfortunately

explanation.definitionFit: Scented liquid splashed on the face after shaving is a male cosmetic.

clue.text: Nothing is heard of sister

parts.note: none means not any, nothing

clue.text: As an illustration dressed in unadorned fabric

explanation.walkthrough: Barege is a sheer, gauzy dress fabric of wool and silk, named after Barèges in the Pyrenees.
explanation.definitionFit: A light, sheer woollen dress material is a textile.

clue.text: One egg I consumed, to start

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a nit is the egg of a louse
ate means consumed
